note: Free asset sources for the find-assets skill. verifiedOn null means: read the license page before use. A dated entry is still a pointer; the license text on the source governs. Search with kit/skills/find-assets/scripts/assets.py.

groups.components: HTML, CSS, Tailwind and React components, primitives, templates and registries.
groups.icons: Interface icon sets, brand marks and icon tooling.
groups.fonts: Typeface libraries, single families and self-host packages.
groups.illustration: Illustration sets, vector libraries, pattern and background generators.
groups.photo-video: Stock photos, stock video and open-access museum and agency media.
groups.3d: 3D models, HDRIs, materials and the web 3D toolchain.
groups.motion: Animation libraries, animation file players and programmatic video tools.
groups.dataviz: Chart, map and graph libraries, plus chart-choice guidance (reference only).
groups.color-type-tools: Color scales, palette tools, type scale tools and font metric tools.
groups.inspiration: Reference galleries. Reference only: nothing from them enters a project.
groups.logo-aids: Vector tools, favicon tools and trademark search services.

commercialUse.yes: Commercial use is allowed with no limit that the catalog knows.
commercialUse.yes-with-limits: Commercial use is allowed with a use limit. Read the license field.
commercialUse.varies: Each item sets its own terms. Check the item, not the source.
commercialUse.reference-only: Study it. Nothing from it enters a project.
commercialUse.unknown: Terms were not found. Blocked until the license is read.

attribution.notice: No visible credit. Keep the license or NOTICE file with the files.
attribution.requested: A credit is asked for and is not a license condition.
attribution.required: A visible credit is a license condition.
attribution.varies: Each item sets its own rule.

sources.name: shadcn/ui
sources.holds: Copy-in React components on Radix or Base UI with Tailwind; CLI and registry format. Baseline for most React work; you own the code after copy-in.
sources.license: MIT. Keep the copyright notice if you redistribute the source.
sources.attribution: none: no credit in the product
sources.risk: Default look is common; restyle with tokens.

sources.name: shadcn registry directory
sources.holds: Index of third-party shadcn registries (directory.json in shadcn-ui/ui); several hundred entries on 2026-11-23. Fast way to discover niche components.
sources.license: Varies per registry. Each registry sets its own license.
sources.risk: Per-registry license varies; unknown code quality; review code before install. Checked from the repository README or a data file, not from the license file.

sources.name: Magic UI

sources.attribution: none: no credit in the product
sources.risk: Overused effects read as template; Pro templates are paid.

sources.attribution: unknown: none stated in the summary that was read
sources.fetch: npx shadcn@latest add @aceternity/<name> or copy from site
sources.risk: Custom license; no marketplace templates; some components carry third-party licenses. Terms come from a search summary; read the license page before use.
